metadata.notes: Pass1 current seasonal offer:22 new private items plus120cm sourced Namazu condition. Existing Namazu ID/model/date preserved. Map2026 personally inspected; A-D are vertical levels, not thematic lands. Films/programmes at Astrodôme/CinéMax belong to their existing named physical venues and are not duplicate cinemas. Machine Terre/Seismes guided visits belong to their exhibitions. No GPS from schematic underground map; exact position research remains. No guessed opening dates: Astrodôme2023 and Hawaï2026 only, latter inaugurated1July but inauguration not assumed first public day. Hawaï90/110cm sources conflict, no restriction asserted until qualified. Playground age ranges and accessibility conditions to complete separately, no MaxAge enum invented. Durations are official whole-experience durations. No public description yet, private until editorial audit. Carnets2026 display content not a new permanent installation date. Official Terre en colère copy misleadingly groups earthquakes/volcanoes with climate change; do not adopt causal statement in prose. Historical/replaced offer pass still required.
